resources.string: Guardian controls affect this device only. Leaving the app or pressing Back locks guardian access. Reviewers and mail providers do not receive a copy of these controls.
Enter the date of birth of the person who will use the mailbox. Only an age group is kept on this device. The date is discarded and is not sent to a server. Users under 18 use supervised mail.
Date of birth of the mailbox user
Enter the date of birth of the child who will use supervised mail.
A parent or guardian must set this up

An adult must manage this mailbox, approve contacts and review each message before a child can read or send it. Use a mailbox the provider permits the child to use. These local controls do not verify adult identity or establish legally verified parental consent. They do not control other apps, webmail or other devices.
Date of birth of the parent or guardian
New guardian PIN: at least 6 digits

Keep this PIN private. The app stores a protected PIN verifier, not the PIN. There is no PIN recovery. Clearing app data removes local mail, controls and unsent messages; it does not remove the provider account.
I checked that this provider permits this child to use the mailbox and that I am authorized to connect it.

Use only accounts you are permitted to access. Do not send threats, harassment, hate, scams, spam, malware, unlawful material, sexual exploitation or private information without authority. Do not send sexual content to children. In supervised mail, an adult manages contacts and reviews each incoming and outgoing message. Keep the guardian PIN private. Stop and ask a trusted adult about unwanted or worrying messages. Blocking and requests for guardian review stay local; provider action uses the provider’s official process. Read and accept these acceptable-use rules before continuing.
This action could not be completed. Check the details, guardian access and connection, then try again.
Hand the device to your parent or guardian. Only the adult who set up this PIN should enter it.
The PIN was not accepted. After repeated attempts, wait before trying again.
Read and write together with your parent or guardian. Ask them to read the words aloud if you need help.
Be kind. Keep passwords, your home address and private pictures to yourself. If a message worries you, stop and ask a trusted adult. A familiar sender name can be fake.
Mail communication is paused. Ask your parent or guardian.
No reviewed messages yet. Your parent or guardian must check each message before it appears here.
Load and review the complete message before approving it.
This saves a request on this device for your guardian to review. It is not sent to the sender, mail provider or app developer. Tell a trusted adult now if you need help.
I have read the safety reminder with my parent or guardian.
Your adult approved the exact message and it was queued for sending. Ask them to check delivery.
You read and write plain text in supervised mail. Attachments, clickable links, remote pictures, external sharing and device contacts are not available here.
Ask my adult to review and send

Parent or guardian: read the exact recipient, subject and complete message below. Check that sharing this information is appropriate and authorized. The message cannot be changed after this approval without another review.
I have reviewed this exact text and recipient and authorize this message.
Approve and send this exact text

Read the whole message before making it visible to the child. Check age suitability and personal information. Sender addresses and names can be forged: an approved address does not prove who wrote the message. Only the reviewed plain text will be shown, without attachments.
This sender is not yet an approved contact. Review the exact address before allowing it.
Approve this exact text for the child
Block this sender on this device
Set up this device for a child
Only approved contacts and individually reviewed messages are allowed. Turning this off pauses communication and revokes outstanding send permissions. It does not remove messages already delivered.
Previously approved incoming messages will disappear from child view. Pending outgoing messages must be approved again. Already delivered mail cannot be recalled.
Add one exact email address at a time. Approval does not authenticate the sender or automatically approve any message. Removing a contact also removes its message permissions.
These requests stay on this device. Review the message, talk with the child, block the sender or use the provider report form if appropriate.

Blocking hides mail from this exact address and prevents communication with it in this app on this device. It does not block delivery at the mail server or in other apps. A sender can use a different address.
Open each message and review the complete text. Only individually approved messages from approved contacts appear in child view.
No messages are available. Add an authorized mailbox and check for mail.

Use the official abuse or safety address published by your mail provider. Enter that address yourself and describe only what is necessary. No original message, headers or attachments are included automatically. The app developer does not operate a mail moderation service. If your provider uses a web form instead, an adult must use that official process outside this app.
An authorized mailbox is needed to send a provider report.
Official provider abuse or safety email
The report was queued. Keep the guardian session open until it is sent; leaving the app pauses an unsent report. Check the outbox or sent folder before assuming delivery.

This sends the previewed text with your sender identity and normal email headers through your mailbox. No original correspondence or attachments are included automatically. Confirm the official destination and remove unnecessary personal information before sending.
Family safety settings blocked this action. Ask your parent or guardian to review the account, contact and exact message.
The report was queued for sending. Check the outbox or sent folder before assuming delivery.
You can stop messages from this address on this device. Ask your guardian before allowing the address again.
